21351.tail: Pair it with the pink heart-lock listing or wear it alone - either way it is the softest hardware look in the category, and the adjustment range covers the standard neck sizes without gaps.
21351.short_add: Softest hardware-inspired collar on the site, pairs with pink outfits.

21083.tail: Built on the same leather band as the year-round collars, it outlasts the holiday by design - one October purchase that keeps its finish through every season after.
21083.short_add: One October purchase built to outlast the season.

21088.tail: It layers under sleeveless tops as easily as it stands alone with a costume, and the pink-plus-sparkle combination suits gift occasions from Valentine's to birthdays without any styling effort.
21088.short_add: Suits gifts and pink-themed outfits alike with zero styling effort.

22074.tail: For buyers collecting genre costumes beyond the nurse-and-maid defaults, this is the action entry - and the all-black palette means it doubles as a sleek foundation piece under other outfits.
22074.short_add: Doubles as a sleek foundation piece under other costumes.

21194.tail: It is the collar that answers the first-purchase question: nothing to configure, nothing to match, one shade that goes with everything already hanging in the lingerie drawer.
21194.short_add: Nothing to configure or match - one shade suits everything.

21355.tail: Between the street-styling reference and the vintage wash, this is the collar that survives trends rather than following them - buy it for one outfit and keep it for the wardrobe.
21355.short_add: A collar bought for one outfit and kept for the wardrobe.

19053.tail: Two sizes by weight rather than one-size optimism, and the elastic fit means the S-M split lands where it should rather than where a chart hopes - measure once, order once, wear it either way.
19053.short_add: Measure once, order once, and wear it as costume or suit.

20493.tail: The headwear identifies the maid theme from across a room while the sheer skirt settles the register at conversational distance - one set working at both ranges without a single accessory added.
20493.short_add: Works at party distance and close range without additions.

20652.tail: Two pieces, one motion to dress, and a pink that photographs warmer than the black default - the simplest complete maid-format listing for buyers who already know the genre.
20652.short_add: The simplest complete maid format in the softest colorway.

21239.tail: The set pairing means the accents arrive balanced rather than assembled - one purchase, one shade decision, and a collar that finishes both lingerie looks and costume evenings on equal terms.
21239.short_add: One purchase and one shade decision finish any look.

21269.tail: Three shades cover the standard palettes - red for costume, black for layering, white for bridal-adjacent - and the cutout pattern keeps all three reading as design rather than sheer coverage alone.
21269.short_add: Cutout pattern keeps all three shades reading as design.

20551.tail: Blue is the reference colorway for a reason, and milk silk is the reason to pick this listing over the polyester versions - the softest student set on the site by a clear margin.
20551.short_add: The softest student-set fabric by a clear margin.

21092.tail: White reads ice and black reads evening on the same plush band, and the pearl-dotted snowflake design photographs as well on a gift box as on a costume - December accessory, January keep.
21092.short_add: Photographs on gift boxes and costumes equally well.

20544.tail: The chest panel carries the design so the rest of the jumpsuit stays simple, and chiffon holds cutout edges without fraying - the openwork pattern survives washing where woven detail would not.
20544.short_add: Openwork holds through washing where wovens fray.

19250.tail: The strap skirt is where the bunny detail lives, so the JK reference stays clean above the waist - two genres sharing one garment without either one shouting over the other.
19250.short_add: Two genres sharing one garment in quiet balance.

20506.tail: The blue colorway is the calm register in a category that leans red and black, and the chiffon-and-lace pairing reads designed rather than assembled - a one-piece answer to gifting occasions.
20506.short_add: The calm register for gifting among louder colorways.

19665.tail: Coordinated arrival is the entire value: crossover themes assembled from separate listings never quite match, and this one resolves the bunny-maid question at the source, in pink polyester.
19665.short_add: Resolves the crossover-matching problem at the source.

20382.tail: Pink and black split the JK read between sweet and sharp on the same sheer cut, and the clothing-only format suits buyers who already own the accessories this genre accumulates.
20382.short_add: Suits buyers who already own the genre accessories.

20601.tail: The 40-70 kg range is the widest claim in the fitted-top category, and the two-piece format means one half can serve other costumes when the other half is in the wash.
20601.short_add: One size to 70 kg with mix-and-match halves.

20619.tail: Sheer chiffon makes the kitten-maid crossover a bedroom piece by fabric rather than by cut - the design reads costume, the material decides where it gets worn, and both halves arrive together.
20619.short_add: Fabric decides the room; the design reads costume.

20679.tail: Navy polyester tolerates actual water, which separates it from costume-grade versions of the same silhouette - school-swimsuit reference that survives its own reference material.
20679.short_add: Survives water better than costume-grade versions.

19888.tail: Complete-set purchase removes the improvisation that catgirl costumes usually demand - the ears and tail that get self-sourced never match, and here they arrive matching the outfit.
19888.short_add: Ears and tail arrive matching the outfit itself.

20596.tail: The wrap-and-belt construction is what lets one size honestly claim 40-65 kg - the fit adjusts at the waist rather than assuming one shape, and the open-chest cut stays open at every setting.
20596.short_add: Waist adjusts the fit across the whole claimed range.

20040.tail: White for the classic reference and black for the modern one, both with the hat that confirms the read - the simplest complete nurse kit for buyers who value the two-piece format.
20040.short_add: The simplest complete kit in two honest colorways.

21070.tail: Both charms on one band settle the heart-versus-star question without a second order, and the three colorways match the rest of the accessory drawer shade for shade.
21070.short_add: Settles the charm debate in one matching band.

20271.tail: The shirt-cut top breaks the silhouette at the waist where jumpsuit versions run one line - a preference, not a hierarchy, and this listing covers the preference that the one-piece listings skip.
20271.short_add: Covers the waist-break preference one-pieces skip.

20044.tail: Three-point means the accessories carry the costume and the coverage stays minimal by design - a format that rewards buyers who know exactly what they are ordering, which the pictures confirm.
20044.short_add: A format for buyers who checked the pictures first.

20402.tail: The structured plush tail is the piece that photographs - most cat costumes fail at exactly this detail - and the combo options let the stockings join the set or stay out of it.
20402.short_add: The tail detail most cat costumes quietly fail.

22021.tail: The lbs-based chart splits S through L in clean bands, and the split in the skirt does the design work a whole print would otherwise carry - three pieces, black, done.
22021.short_add: Clean bands and a skirt that needs no print.
22021.td: Black polyester secretary set with split hip-baring skirt, top and thong, S-M-L for 85-140 lbs. Three-piece role-play costume by weight.

21129.tail: Denim-finish leather in vintage blue is the one collar in the category that belongs to a wardrobe rather than a costume box - and the smaller 30-40 cm fit is printed, not implied.
21129.short_add: The wardrobe collar in a category of costume pieces.

21240.tail: Blackout versus sheer is the real choice in eye wear, and this listing is the blocking side of it - leather construction, elastic band, three colorways, printed dimensions at 27 by 7 cm.
21240.short_add: The blocking side of the eye-wear choice, three colors.

19932.tail: One garment, no assembly, no accessories to lose - the nun costume survives a crowded room intact where multi-piece costumes shed their props by midnight, and polyester washes it all away after.
19932.short_add: No props to lose by midnight, one garment total.
